question: The coordinates of the centroid of the triangle ABC whose vertices are A(-5, 7), B(-4, -5) and C(4, 5), is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Centroid **G(x, y)** is the average of **x-coordinates** and **y-coordinates** of the vertices.

x = (−5 − 4 + 4) ÷ 3 = −5/3

y = (7 − 5 + 5) ÷ 3 = 7/3

**∴ The correct answer is (−5/3, 7/3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Vertex **A(x₁, y₁)** = (−5, 7)

Vertex **B(x₂, y₂)** = (−4, −5)

Vertex **C(x₃, y₃)** = (4, 5)

**Formula Used:**

Centroid **G(x, y)** = ((x₁ + x₂ + x₃)/3, (y₁ + y₂ + y₃)/3)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c24d7c38e6815301a3975d25deac96a8eca2133582750c9b667ace082e6e1ebd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ x-coordinate of **centroid** = (−5 + (−4) + 4) ÷ 3

⇒ x = (−5 − 4 + 4) ÷ 3 = −5/3

⇒ y-coordinate of **centroid** = (7 + (−5) + 5) ÷ 3

⇒ y = (7 − 5 + 5) ÷ 3 = 7/3

**∴ The correct answer is (−5/3, 7/3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Definition of Centroid

The **centroid** is the point where the three **medians** of a triangle intersect and it divides each median in the ratio **2:1**.

Incenter Formula

The coordinates of the **incenter** are given by (ax₁+bx₂+cx₃)/(a+b+c) and (ay₁+by₂+cy₃)/(a+b+c), where a, b, c are side lengths.

Area of Triangle

Area = 1/2 |x₁(y₂−y₃) + x₂(y₃−y₁) + x₃(y₁−y₂)|.</p
